blurb.heading: Blake Simpson - Technical Lead
blurb.body: I am a passionate full-stack developer who has led teams across diverse environments and built software that matters. My professional background includes working on mission-critical emergency services systems, innovative safety management solutions, groundbreaking interactive experiences, and tools that have engaged and supported vulnerable communities. Proficient in multiple languages and frameworks, I bring creative problem-solving and a human-centered design approach to applications where user experience is critical.

history.title: Technical Lead @ Genvis: Perth 2022-2025
history.body:
- Delivered the successful pitch to secure the Emergency WA platform rework contract for the WA Government's Department of Fire and Emergency Services (2024)
- Led teams across multiple phases to deliver Emergency WA, a mission-critical and highly available emergency services platform serving all responders across WA
- Rapidly rebranded, reconfigured and deployed our solution to support the Manitoba government during 2025 Canadian wildfire crisis, enabling critical emergency response coordination for vulnerable populations
- Ensured 99.9999% uptime through AWS multi-region architecture, auto-scaling, CloudWatch alerting and automated disaster recovery
- Maintained active security clearance for government systems access
- Architected and developed highly available software solutions using modern frameworks and AWS cloud infrastructure
- Established coding standards, review processes, and WCAG 2.2 accessibility compliance across all platform applications
- Coordinated agile workflows and sprint planning for distributed development team as Scrum Master

history.title: Senior Developer @ Insig Technologies: Perth 2019-2022
history.body:
- Architected and developed innovative software solutions using modern frameworks and on-premise Kubernetes cluster deployments
- Managed on-premise deployments across multiple mining operations in developing nations
- Developed VR safety training and LiDAR visualizations for international mining operations
- Created reusable UI library adopted across 6 projects, reducing development time and ensuring UX consistency
- Transformed complex industrial workflows into user-friendly digital experiences
- Coordinated agile workflows and sprint planning for distributed development team as Scrum Master

history.title: Lead Developer @ Binary Space: Perth 2017-2019
history.body:
- Led a team to develop 'Ghoul Britannia: Land of Hope and Gorey', featured in gaming press and exhibited at conventions across Australia, America, and Europe
- Released on Steam with positive reception; Nintendo Switch release in development
- Established agile workflows and drove technical architecture, code reviews, and QA processes for the distributed team

history.title: Developer @ Immersia: Perth 2016
history.body:

history.title: Developer @ SK Games: Perth 2011-2015

history.title: Freelance Developer and Visual Artist: Australia and International 2010-2017
